name: iteration6_positive_completion_full_laws
seed_rule: base_seed + 1000 * modes; same U for the three profiles at each size and seed
native_crosscheck: retained_k4 on every instance, independent frozen C++ product binary; validation only, no cross-language speed claims
table_crosscheck: all four completion laws on the six m8 instances, same Gaussian selector and independently summed complete-target event probabilities
failure_policy: Every unresolved reachable prefix contributes its full probability weight to an explicit failure symbol; never renormalize successes or retry a case
continuation_rule: Compare each completion to its same-k baseline and the stronger k4/k6 baselines. If completion has no material TV improvement on any fixed input, retain the failure and start an alternative route without waiting for user input.
claim_scope: No universal TV guarantee, classical-limit breakthrough, asymptotic exact-GBS speedup, native throughput claim, or novelty claim follows from this exploratory matrix. The Gaussian support theorem assumes exact local probabilities.
